mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alphafrog_agent_run (id, user_id, status, current_step, max_steps, plan_json, snapshot_json, last_error, ttl_expires_at, ext, tool_job_anchor_json) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{currentStep}, #{maxSteps}, CAST(#{planJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{snapshotJson} AS jsonb), #{lastError}, #{ttlExpiresAt}, CAST(#{ext} AS jsonb), COALESCE(CAST(#{toolJobAnchorJson} AS jsonb), '{}'::jsonb))
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, status, current_step, max_steps, plan_json::text AS plan_json, snapshot_json::text AS snapshot_json, last_error, ttl_expires_at, started_at, updated_at, completed_at, ext::text AS ext, tool_job_anchor_json::text AS tool_job_anchor_json FROM alphafrog_agent_run WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id, status, current_step, max_steps, plan_json::text AS plan_json, snapshot_json::text AS snapshot_json, last_error, ttl_expires_at, started_at, updated_at, completed_at, ext::text AS ext, tool_job_anchor_json::text AS tool_job_anchor_json FROM alphafrog_agent_run WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN (e.payload_json ->> 'totalCreditsConsumed') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (e.payload_json ->> 'totalCreditsConsumed')::int WHEN (e.payload_json ->> 'total_credits_consumed') ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (e.payload_json ->> 'total_credits_consumed')::int ELSE 0 END ), 0) FROM alphafrog_agent_run_event e JOIN alphafrog_agent_run r ON r.id = e.run_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND e.event_type = 'WORKFLOW_COMPLETED'
mapper.update: UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run SET status = 'RECEIVED', current_step = 0, ttl_expires_at = #{ttlExpiresAt}, last_error = NULL, completed_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run SET snapshot_json = jsonb_set( COALESCE(snapshot_json, '{}'::jsonb), '{data_analysis_observability}', CAST(#{nextJson} AS jsonb), true), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND (COALESCE(snapshot_json, '{}'::jsonb) -> 'data_analysis_observability') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM CAST(#{expectedJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb)

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run SET tool_job_anchor_json = CAST(#{toolJobAnchorJson} AS jsonb), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'EXECUTING' AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'operationId' = #{expectedOperationId} AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'blockingOwnerId' = #{expectedOwnerId} AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'runDisposition' = 'DAG_BLOCKING_NO_RESUME' AND COALESCE((tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'autoResume')::boolean, true) = false AND ( NULLIF(tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'blockingLeaseUntil', '') IS NULL OR (tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'blockingLeaseUntil')::timestamptz <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run SET tool_job_anchor_json = CAST('{}' AS jsonb), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'EXECUTING' AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'operationId' = #{expectedOperationId} AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'blockingOwnerId' = #{expectedOwnerId} AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'blockingLeaseUntil' = #{expectedLeaseUntil} AND (tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'blockingLeaseUntil')::timestamptz > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'runDisposition' = 'DAG_BLOCKING_NO_RESUME' AND COALESCE((tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'autoResume')::boolean, true) = false AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'anchorState' = 'TERMINAL' AND NULLIF(tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'terminalStatus', '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'terminalAt', '') IS NOT NULL AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'finalizerStep' = 'USAGE' AND COALESCE((tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'usagePersisted')::boolean, false) = true AND ( (tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'reservationJson')::jsonb ->> 'state' ) = 'RELEASED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM alphafrog_agent_run_event e WHERE e.run_id = alphafrog_agent_run.id AND e.event_type = 'TOOL_CALL_FINISHED' AND e.dedupe_key = CONCAT( alphafrog_agent_run.id, ':', tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'toolCallId', ':logical_terminal' ) )

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run SET tool_job_anchor_json = CAST(#{toolJobAnchorJson} AS jsonb), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('EXECUTING', 'FAILED', 'CANCELED') AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'operationId' = #{expectedOperationId} AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'blockingOwnerId' = #{expectedOwnerId} AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'runDisposition' = 'DAG_BLOCKING_WORKER_LOST' AND COALESCE((tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'autoResume')::boolean, true) = false AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'requestFingerprint' = #{expectedRequestFingerprint} AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'anchorState' = 'PREPARING' AND NULLIF(tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'taskId', '') IS NULL AND ( (tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'reservationJson')::jsonb ->> 'state' ) = 'PREPARING'

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run SET tool_job_anchor_json = CAST('{}' AS jsonb), status = CASE WHEN status = 'EXECUTING' THEN 'FAILED' ELSE status END, last_error = CASE WHEN status = 'EXECUTING' THEN #{lastError} ELSE last_error END, completed_at = CASE WHEN status = 'EXECUTING' THEN COALESCE(completed_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE completed_at END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('EXECUTING', 'FAILED', 'CANCELED') AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'operationId' = #{expectedOperationId} AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'blockingOwnerId' = #{expectedOwnerId} AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'runDisposition' = 'DAG_BLOCKING_WORKER_LOST' AND COALESCE((tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'autoResume')::boolean, true) = false AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'anchorState' = 'TERMINAL' AND NULLIF(tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'terminalStatus', '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'terminalAt', '') IS NOT NULL AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'finalizerStep' = 'EVENT' AND COALESCE((tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'usagePersisted')::boolean, false) = true AND COALESCE((tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'terminalEventEmitted')::boolean, false) = true AND ( (tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'reservationJson')::jsonb ->> 'state' ) = 'RELEASED'
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, status, current_step, max_steps, plan_json::text AS plan_json, snapshot_json::text AS snapshot_json, last_error, ttl_expires_at, started_at, updated_at, completed_at, ext::text AS ext, tool_job_anchor_json::text AS tool_job_anchor_json, 0 AS duration_ms, 0 AS total_tokens, 0 AS tool_calls FROM alphafrog_agent_run WHERE tool_job_anchor_json IS NOT NULL AND tool_job_anchor_json <> '{}'::jsonb AND NOT ( status = 'EXECUTING' AND tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeState}' = 'LAUNCHING' AND COALESCE((tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resultConsumed}')::boolean, false) ) AND ( status IN ('EXECUTING', 'WAITING_TOOL_JOB', 'WAITING') OR ( status IN ('FAILED', 'CANCELED') AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'runDisposition' IN ('DAG_BLOCKING_WORKER_LOST', 'DAG_BLOCKING_PREPARING_ABORT') ) ) ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, user_id, status, current_step, max_steps, plan_json::text AS plan_json, snapshot_json::text AS snapshot_json, last_error, ttl_expires_at, started_at, updated_at, completed_at, ext::text AS ext, tool_job_anchor_json::text AS tool_job_anchor_json, 0 AS duration_ms, 0 AS total_tokens, 0 AS tool_calls FROM alphafrog_agent_run WHERE tool_job_anchor_json IS NOT NULL AND tool_job_anchor_json <> '{}'::jsonb AND ( ( status = 'RECEIVED' AND NOT (tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeState}' = 'READY' AND COALESCE((tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resultConsumed}')::boolean, false)) AND ( tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeState}' = 'READY' OR ( tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeState}' = 'LAUNCHING' AND ( tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeLauncherLeaseUntil}' IS NULL OR (tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeLauncherLeaseUntil}')::timestamptz <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ) ) ) OR ( status = 'EXECUTING' AND tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeState}' IN ('LAUNCHING', 'ACCEPTED') AND COALESCE((tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resultConsumed}')::boolean, false) AND ( tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeLauncherLeaseUntil}' IS NULL OR (tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeLauncherLeaseUntil}')::timestamptz <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ) ) ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, user_id, status, current_step, max_steps, plan_json::text AS plan_json, snapshot_json::text AS snapshot_json, last_error, ttl_expires_at, started_at, updated_at, completed_at, ext::text AS ext, tool_job_anchor_json::text AS tool_job_anchor_json, 0 AS duration_ms, 0 AS total_tokens, 0 AS tool_calls FROM alphafrog_agent_run WHERE tool_job_anchor_json IS NOT NULL AND tool_job_anchor_json <> '{}'::jsonb AND status = 'RECEIVED' AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'finalizerStep' = 'CAS_STATUS' AND (tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeState}' IS NULL OR btrim(tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeState}') = '') AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'operationId' IS NOT NULL AND btrim(tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'operationId') <> '' AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'toolCallId' IS NOT NULL AND btrim(tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'toolCallId') <> '' AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'taskId' IS NOT NULL AND btrim(tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'taskId') <> '' AND CASE WHEN tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'attempt' ~ '^[0-9]{1,10}$' THEN (tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'attempt')::bigint ELSE -1 END BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647 AND ( tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'resumeLeaseVersion' IS NULL OR btrim(tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'resumeLeaseVersion') = '' OR ( CASE WHEN tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'resumeLeaseVersion' ~ '^[0-9]{1,19}$' THEN (tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'resumeLeaseVersion')::numeric ELSE -1 END BETWEEN 0 AND 9223372036854775806 ) ) ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run SET tool_job_anchor_json = tool_job_anchor_json || jsonb_build_object( 'resumeState', 'READY', 'resumeToken', #{newResumeToken}::text, 'resumeLeaseVersion', CASE WHEN tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'resumeLeaseVersion' IS NULL OR btrim(tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'resumeLeaseVersion') = '' THEN 1 WHEN CASE WHEN tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'resumeLeaseVersion' ~ '^[0-9]{1,19}$' THEN (tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'resumeLeaseVersion')::numeric ELSE -1 END BETWEEN 0 AND 9223372036854775806 THEN (tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'resumeLeaseVersion')::bigint + 1 ELSE -1 END, 'resumeClaimedAt', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'finalizerStep', 'RESUME_READY' ), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RECEIVED' AND tool_job_anchor_json IS NOT NULL AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'finalizerStep' = 'CAS_STATUS' AND (tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeState}' IS NULL OR btrim(tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeState}') = '') AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'operationId' = #{expectedOperationId} AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'toolCallId' = #{expectedToolCallId} AND CASE WHEN tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'attempt' ~ '^[0-9]{1,10}$' THEN (tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'attempt')::bigint ELSE -1 END = #{expectedAttempt} AND tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'taskId' = #{expectedTaskId} AND COALESCE( CASE WHEN tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'resumeLeaseVersion' IS NULL OR btrim(tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'resumeLeaseVersion') = '' THEN 0 WHEN tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'resumeLeaseVersion' ~ '^[0-9]{1,19}$' AND CASE WHEN tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'resumeLeaseVersion' ~ '^[0-9]{1,19}$' THEN (tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'resumeLeaseVersion')::numeric ELSE -1 END BETWEEN 0 AND 9223372036854775806 THEN (tool_job_anchor_json ->> 'resumeLeaseVersion')::bigint ELSE -1 END, 0) = #{expectedResumeLeaseVersion}

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run SET tool_job_anchor_json = CAST(#{toolJobAnchorJson} AS jsonb) || jsonb_build_object( 'resumeLauncherOwnerId', #{launcherOwnerId}::text, 'resumeClaimedAt', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'resumeLauncherLeaseUntil', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}) ), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus} AND ( -- 合法组合：RECEIVED + LAUNCHING + 未接受（正常等待接管） (status = 'RECEIVED' AND tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeState}' = 'LAUNCHING' AND NOT COALESCE((tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resultConsumed}')::boolean, false)) OR -- 合法组合：EXECUTING + (LAUNCHING legacy 或 ACCEPTED) + 已接受 (status = 'EXECUTING' AND tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeState}' IN ('LAUNCHING', 'ACCEPTED') AND COALESCE((tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resultConsumed}')::boolean, false)) ) AND tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeToken}' = #{expectedResumeToken} AND (tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeLeaseVersion}')::bigint = #{expectedLeaseVersion} AND (tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeLauncherOwnerId}') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{expectedLauncherOwnerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ( ( tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeLauncherLeaseUntil}' IS NOT NULL AND (tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeLauncherLeaseUntil}')::timestamptz <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) OR ( tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeLauncherLeaseUntil}' IS NULL AND ( tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeClaimedAt}' IS NULL OR (tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeClaimedAt}')::timestamptz <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - make_interval(secs => #{legacyStaleSeconds}) ) ) )

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run SET tool_job_anchor_json = jsonb_set( tool_job_anchor_json, '{resumeLauncherLeaseUntil}', to_jsonb(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds})), true ), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND ( -- 合法组合：RECEIVED + LAUNCHING + 未接受 (status = 'RECEIVED' AND tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeState}' = 'LAUNCHING' AND NOT COALESCE((tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resultConsumed}')::boolean, false)) OR -- 合法组合：EXECUTING + (LAUNCHING legacy 或 ACCEPTED) + 已接受 (status = 'EXECUTING' AND tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeState}' IN ('LAUNCHING', 'ACCEPTED') AND COALESCE((tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resultConsumed}')::boolean, false)) ) AND tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeToken}' = #{expectedResumeToken} AND (tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeLeaseVersion}')::bigint = #{expectedLeaseVersion} AND tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeLauncherOwnerId}' = #{expectedLauncherOwnerId} AND (tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeLauncherLeaseUntil}')::timestamptz > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run SET tool_job_anchor_json = CAST(#{toolJobAnchorJson} AS jsonb) || jsonb_build_object( 'resumeLauncherOwnerId', #{expectedLauncherOwnerId}::text, 'resumeLauncherLeaseUntil', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}) ), status = 'EXECUTING', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RECEIVED' AND tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeState}' = 'LAUNCHING' AND NOT COALESCE((tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resultConsumed}')::boolean, false) AND tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeToken}' = #{expectedResumeToken} AND (tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeLeaseVersion}')::bigint = #{expectedLeaseVersion} AND tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeLauncherOwnerId}' = #{expectedLauncherOwnerId} AND (tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeLauncherLeaseUntil}')::timestamptz > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run SET plan_json = COALESCE(CAST(#{planJson} AS jsonb), plan_json), status = #{status}, snapshot_json = CAST(#{snapshotJson} AS jsonb), completed_at = CASE WHEN #{completed} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE completed_at END, last_error = #{lastError}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'EXECUTING' AND tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeState}' IN ('LAUNCHING', 'ACCEPTED') AND COALESCE((tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resultConsumed}')::boolean, false) AND tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeToken}' = #{expectedResumeToken} AND (tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeLeaseVersion}')::bigint = #{expectedLeaseVersion} AND tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeLauncherOwnerId}' = #{expectedLauncherOwnerId} AND (tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{resumeLauncherLeaseUntil}')::timestamptz > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE alphafrog_agent_run SET tool_job_anchor_json = tool_job_anchor_json || jsonb_build_object('checkpointVersion', (COALESCE((tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{checkpointVersion}')::int, 0) + 1)::text::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('todoId', #{todoId}::text) || jsonb_build_object('sequence', #{sequence,jdbcType=INTEGER}) || CASE WHEN #{completedTodosJson}::text IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('completedTodosJson', '[]'::text) ELSE jsonb_build_object('completedTodosJson', #{completedTodosJson}::text) END || jsonb_build_object('datasetSnapshotJson', #{datasetSnapshotJson}::text) || jsonb_build_object('datasetSnapshotDigest', #{datasetSnapshotDigest}::text) || CASE WHEN #{datasetRefsJson}::text IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('datasetRefsJson', '[]'::text) ELSE jsonb_build_object('datasetRefsJson', #{datasetRefsJson}::text) END || jsonb_build_object('toolCallsUsed', #{toolCallsUsed,jdbcType=INTEGER}) || CASE WHEN #{estimateJson}::text IS NULL THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE jsonb_build_object('estimateJson', #{estimateJson}::text) END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus} AND tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{operationId}' = #{expectedOperationId} AND tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{toolCallId}' = #{expectedToolCallId} AND (tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{attempt}')::int = #{expectedAttempt} AND tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{taskId}' = #{expectedTaskId} AND COALESCE((tool_job_anchor_json #>> '{checkpointVersion}')::int, 0) = #{expectedCheckpointVersion}
